exposure: Continuous locked single layer uterine closure
outcome: Uterine scar thickness at 6 weeks and 6-24 months postpartum
finding: Double layer uterine closure was associated with a thicker myometrium scar only in women who underwent primary or elective cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Double layer uterine closure was associated with a thicker myometrium scar only in women who underwent primary or elective cesarean delivery.
